description: An absolute same-host stylesheet answers 500 with a css-looking body: critical drops it (the failed HEAD probes mean the body is never read).

/wp-content/themes/twentytest/broken.css.body:
/* 500 error body that looks like css */
.error-body{content:"500"}

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on the page's own host fails the whole job (decision: shipping critical css that silently lacks the owner's own rules is worse than shipping none). The error body is never used as css. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: the stylesheet same-host rule compares hostname:port with the scheme ignored, the notion the url() rebasing uses.)
